index_title: Direct unary real closure, individually named owners and induced unions
scope: Private B031: exactly ONE remaining Foundations II result. Expand the older direct canonical-hull proof of acl_M(A)=F[A], its harmless finite actual E-owner naming, and acl in a G-invariant full owner union. The specialized forward harmless proof is REPEATED LOCALLY to avoid silently deleting countability from the broader packaged B022 type. Main closure branches use no countability, finite-exact normalization except for thin translations, SAP, EPPA, rooted theorem or HKN. Countability and actual joint lifting belong ONLY to separate ancillary owner-named homogeneity. F and Gamma need not be exact; the unique minimal INFINITE E is retained throughout. B025 already uses its independent shorter B012 unary proof and is not assigned a new dependency here.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Original real closure, finite imaginary parameters, full-packet union definability and optional countable homogeneity have separate premise branches.

assumptions.name: Infinite actual homogeneous real source
assumptions.statement: M is INFINITE nonempty transitive homogeneous in a FINITE complete symmetric binary language of actual equality-inclusive pair orbitals. Invariant binary relations are unions of these atom names and commute. Real acl means finite orbit under FULL Aut(M/A). Neither countability nor real SAP is part of this premise.

assumptions.name: Standing AP and semantic homomorphic CCO
assumptions.statement: Retain age AP and semantic homomorphic CCO for the prepared canonical real-hull, packet and actual exact-sort providers. The canonical finite hull contract, rather than an unsupported converse type criterion, is used. No EPPA, safe palette or normalized construction is assumed.

assumptions.name: Unique minimal infinite direction in FULL invariant lattice
assumptions.statement: E is the UNIQUE inclusion-minimal invariant equivalence with infinite real classes in the FULL finite invariant-equivalence lattice. It need not be a unique minimal nonidentity equivalence. Greatest finite F may be NONEXACT and intersect E nontrivially. Normalization alone does not replace this uniqueness premise.

assumptions.name: Finite original real parameter set
assumptions.statement: A is any finite real subset of M, possibly empty. In the owner-union conclusion A is additionally contained in N_B; no original real representatives of the named imaginary owner classes are fixed as parameters.

assumptions.name: Optional finite-exact-normalized source
assumptions.statement: ONLY for the thin-function/owner-union branch, M has no nonidentity finite-class FULL RAW EXACT invariant equivalence. This yields thin F atoms; thinness is not assumed to imply normalization. Unique minimal infinite E from A03 is still required.

assumptions.name: Finitely many actual owners named individually
assumptions.statement: B is any FINITE set of ACTUAL E-equivalence classes of M, possibly empty. Each member is named individually as an imaginary parameter or unary owner predicate. B is not a chosen set of real representatives and is not merely preserved setwise.

assumptions.name: Optional entire thin-owner invariant set
assumptions.statement: ONLY in the normalized owner-union branch B is invariant under the induced action of the full finite thin group G on M/E. The real G action is regular on F-packets; its owner action may be nonfaithful or nonfree. No full Aut(B), EPPA, packet closure in M/E or group section is assumed.

assumptions.name: Optional current joint-lifting countability
assumptions.statement: ONLY for the ancillary N_B homogeneity branch retain countability from the existing RAW joint-exact lifting API. None of the three closure conclusions invokes that API or this assumption.

imports.name: Greatest finite-class packet relation
imports.statement: Select ONLY finite_packets C03: finite-index coarsenings in the finite commuting equivalence lattice are finite-join closed, constructing F=Sigma(Id). F is a definable union of original atom names, reflexive and finite-class; no exactness of F is supplied.

imports.name: Finite canonical real hull
imports.statement: Select canonical_hull C34: if x is algebraic over finite real A and x notin A, its anchored intersection of Gamma(col(x,a)) classes is FINITE. Only this implication and its contrapositive are used; Gamma need not be exact. The source AP/CCO scope is retained.

imports.name: Nonthin packets construct a forbidden finite exact kernel
imports.statement: Select ONLY C22: a nonthin F atom yields a NONIDENTITY finite-class FULL RAW EXACT kernel by the explicit finite-regularization powers. Contradict A05 LOCALLY to prove thin F. Do not import the countability-bundled normalization chain C24/C25.

imports.name: Literal finite thin translations
imports.statement: Under an EXPLICIT thin-F hypothesis, C26-C28 give one total 0-definable unique-neighbour map t_g per F atom including Id, their finite elementary abelian group, regularity on each real F-packet and original-global automorphism/centrality. A t_g may permute individually named owners and is NOT thereby an automorphism of owner-named N_B.

imports.name: Minimal infinite E is actual full exact
imports.statement: Select C11/C12: in the standing source E=kappa(E) is actual full RAW exact. Its quotient-source inheritance and EPPA are not needed. This exactness is used ONLY in the optional mixed-map/joint-lifting branch, not in the direct closure proof.

imports.name: Mixed real/exact-owner orbital recognition
imports.statement: RAW C17 for Id<=E: Id;a;E=a;E=E;a;E, including actual equality. The actual real/owner orbital is determined by the quotient pair orbital, so an owner-preserving real map plus identity on ALL B preserves every mixed pair.

imports.name: ONE finite real/exact-sort lift
imports.statement: RAW C23: a genuine finite joint original-real/full-exact-owner partial isomorphism is induced by ONE ambient original automorphism. Keep the current countability scope A08; no global action section or surjectivity of full restriction groups is assumed.

reused_proof_patterns.usage: The current packaged provider bundles countability. C08-C13/N04 repeat its FORWARD good-real-representative proof specialized to the unique E; this explicit local proof has no joint lift or countability use. This is proof provenance, NOT an imported theorem with silently weakened premises. Reverse necessity C31-C32 is not used.

definitions.name: Actual F and its finite hull
definitions.statement: F=Sigma(Id) is the greatest finite-class invariant equivalence; F[A]=union_(a in A)F[a]. It is finite for finite A, includes A and is A-definable. Empty A gives the empty union.

definitions.name: Canonical Gamma and anchored intersection
definitions.statement: For genuine diversity atom p, Gamma(p) is the least ACTUAL invariant equivalence containing p, possibly NONEXACT. For x outside A define J_A=meet_(a in A)Gamma(col(x,a)); its x-class equals the intersection of the displayed a-classes. Empty meet is Top.

definitions.name: Three different stabilizer actions
definitions.statement: G_A=FULL Aut(M/A), H_A,B=Aut(M/A, EACH actual E-class in B), and K_A=FULL Aut(N_B/A) in the induced owner-named language. H is an ambient subgroup; its RESTRICTION IMAGE is a subgroup of K, but need not be equal to K or faithful.

definitions.name: Full induced owner union and its exact language
definitions.statement: N_B=pi_E^-1(B) is the ENTIRE union of named E-classes, with all literal old fine colours and one predicate for EACH owner. Only definitional expansions by existing thin graphs/functions are allowed, not arbitrary new predicates that destroy the restriction action. B empty gives the empty carrier, treated separately from nonempty source APIs.

definitions.name: Bad colours for one infinite E-class
definitions.statement: For the specialized harmless argument, p is bad when E intersect(p;p) is contained in F. For any E-class C and fixed x, all p-neighbours in C then lie in one finite F-packet. Actual p;p includes equality.

definitions.name: Literal thin group and induced owner action
definitions.statement: Under A05, G is the finite group of maps t_g from I04, including identity; F[a]={t_g(a):g in G}. Each original-global t_g preserves E and hence acts on actual M/E. Owner action is allowed nonfaithful; no origins in packets are chosen.

definitions.name: Total definable functions versus named automorphisms
definitions.statement: On G-invariant N_B every t_g restricts to a TOTAL 0-definable function by its unique original colour graph. It may permute B owner predicates, so function definability does not place it in Aut(N_B) with all owners individually named.

definitions.name: Actual owner-extended finite map
definitions.statement: For the ancillary homogeneity proof p is an owner-preserving finite original fine-colour partial isomorphism on N_B. Extend p by identity on the ENTIRE actual quotient set B, merging duplicate actual owner values. Mixed real/owner pairs require I06 before I07 may be applied.

claims.name: Finite definable packets give the lower real inclusion
claims.statement: For each finite A, F[A] is finite and A-definable by the finite union of actual F colour names. Every full ambient automorphism fixing A preserves this finite set. Hence F[A] subset acl_M(A), with no exactness or normalization of F.

claims.name: Empty real base has no algebraic point
claims.statement: For A empty, transitivity makes every Aut(M)-orbit all of INFINITE M. Therefore acl_M(empty)=empty=F[empty].

claims.name: An outside-packet point has only genuine diversity spokes
claims.statement: If x notin F[A], reflexivity of F implies x notin A; for every a in A the colour p_a=col(x,a) is a genuine diversity atom, and x Gamma(p_a) a. No Gamma(Id) substitution is needed.

claims.name: Every spoke equivalence is infinite-class
claims.statement: If Gamma(p_a) had finite classes, greatest-finite maximality gives Gamma(p_a)<=F, so xFa, contrary to C03. Thus every spoke equivalence has infinite classes even when it is not exact.

claims.name: The SAME unique E lies in every spoke
claims.statement: Every infinite invariant equivalence in the finite full lattice contains a minimal infinite member; by A03 it must be E. Consequently E[x] lies in every a-class Gamma(p_a), so the entire canonical intersection is infinite. For A empty the intersection is M.

claims.name: Canonical hull contrapositive excludes outside points
claims.statement: For nonempty finite A and x notin F[A], C03 permits I02 and C05 makes the canonical hull infinite. Therefore x cannot be algebraic over A. Only algebraic=>finite-hull is contraposed; no converse is invented.

claims.name: Direct unary real closure for EVERY finite A
claims.statement: C01/C06 give acl_M(A)=F[A] for nonempty finite A; C02 handles empty A. No finite-exact normalization, owner parameters, countability, SAP, EPPA, NR2 or joint lifting enters this branch.

claims.name: Naming owners retains the finite lower closure
claims.statement: Adding actual named owner parameters only shrinks the ambient stabilizer. Thus the finite G_A orbit of any point in F[A] stays finite under H_A,B; F[A] subset acl_M^eq(A union B) intersect M.

claims.name: Every bad-colour neighbour set is finite
claims.statement: For a bad p and each named E-class C, two p-neighbours b,bprime of x inside C lie in E and in p;p by symmetry. Hence bFbprime. This whole neighbour set is contained in ONE finite F-class. There are only finitely many old atomic colours.

claims.name: Choose genuine good representatives for ALL finite owners
claims.statement: For EACH actual C in finite B, remove the finite union of bad-colour neighbour sets from its INFINITE E-class and also remove {x}. Choose one real b_C outside. Then p_C=col(x,b_C) is genuine diversity and is not bad. This choice does NOT assert real representatives are named parameters.

claims.name: Good representative spokes contain E
claims.statement: For each chosen p_C, E intersect(p_C;p_C) is not contained in F. The invariant equivalence E intersect Gamma(p_C) contains it and cannot be finite-class, since all finite-class equivalences lie below F. Minimality of infinite E forces E<=Gamma(p_C). Gamma need not be exact.

claims.name: An infinite hull survives the added REAL representatives
claims.statement: For x notin F[A], C05 and C11 put the SAME infinite E[x] in every spoke class for finite A union {b_C}. C03 and the explicit b_C!=x make all spokes diversity. The contrapositive I02 gives x notin acl_M(A union {b_C}). Empty A and B are included; the wholly empty case uses C02.

claims.name: Finite actual owner naming is harmless for REAL acl
claims.statement: Each actual C is definable from b_C, so Aut(M/A,{b_C}) is a subgroup of H_A,B. The C12 infinite point orbit under this smaller group is contained in the H orbit, making the latter infinite. Thus no x outside F[A] becomes algebraic over the named imaginary owners. With C08, acl_M^eq(A union B) intersect M=F[A]=acl_M(A). This local specialized proof, unlike the broader packaged harmless type, uses no countability.

claims.name: Normalized packets supply the finite literal G
claims.statement: If any F atom were nonthin, I03 C22 would construct a nonidentity finite-class full exact kernel, contradicting A05. Thus F is thin, and I04 supplies finite elementary abelian G, unique-neighbour 0-definable maps and regular real F-packet action. Each t_g is an ORIGINAL-global automorphism central under Aut(M); it need not fix individually named owner classes.

claims.name: Thin translations induce a genuine possibly nonfaithful owner action
claims.statement: Because each t_g preserves every original fine colour and E is a union of such colours, E-related points have E-related images. Thus t_g acts on actual E-classes. This owner action may have a kernel even though the real action is packet-regular.

claims.name: G-invariant B is exactly full-F saturation of its entire union
claims.statement: If B is G-invariant, every a in N_B and every g satisfy t_g(a) in N_B, hence F[a] subset N_B. Conversely, if N_B contains every F-packet of its points, choose a above any b in B; every g b is then the owner of t_g(a) in N_B, so g b lies in B. Includes empty B.

claims.name: Finite packet hull is definable INSIDE the induced union
claims.statement: For A subset N_B, C16 makes each literal t_g total on N_B. Thus EACH value t_g(a) is individually A-definable by a total unique-neighbour function, and F[A]={t_g(a):g in G,a in A} is their finite union. In particular F[A] subset dcl_N(A) subset acl_N(A). The t_g need not be in Aut(N_B).

claims.name: Ambient named stabilizer has a restriction IMAGE subgroup
claims.statement: Every h in H_A,B fixes EACH owner, preserves the entire N_B, old fine colours and the definable thin graphs. Its restriction is in FULL Aut(N_B/A). These restrictions form a subgroup. Their point orbit of x is exactly its ambient H orbit, but restriction need not be injective or surjective onto the full group.

claims.name: Outside-packet points keep infinite induced-union orbits
claims.statement: For x in N_B outside F[A], C13 says its ambient H_A,B orbit is infinite. By C18 it lies wholly in N_B and in the FULL Aut(N_B/A) orbit of x, which is therefore infinite. Thus x is not algebraic in the induced union. Homogeneity and joint lifting are not used.

claims.name: Exact real acl of the G-invariant owner union
claims.statement: For every finite A subset N_B, combine C17/C19: acl_N_B(A)=F[A]=acl_M^eq(A union B) intersect N_B. This is closure in the FULL owner-named induced structure, not a selected subgroup definition. Unique minimal infinite E and normalization/G-invariance have distinct roles.

claims.name: Empty bases, empty owner unions and closed packet unions
claims.statement: If A empty then all three closure sets in C20 are empty. If B empty, N_B is empty and A must be empty, so the result is direct set equality outside any nonempty-source API. Every finite full-F union C subset N_B is absolutely closed there because F[C]=C. No closure-containing rooted empty witness is claimed.

claims.name: Check EVERY mixed pair in the ancillary joint request
claims.statement: For finite owner-preserving p in N_B, p union Id_B preserves real-real colours, all owner-owner colours and, by I06, each mixed real/owner orbital. On each real domain point pi_E(p(x))=pi_E(x), and identity fixes ALL B, including nonincident owner classes. Thus this is a genuine finite joint partial isomorphism.

claims.name: One countable joint lift preserves the whole owner union
claims.statement: Under optional A08, I07 lifts C22 to one ORIGINAL ambient automorphism fixing EACH member of B. It preserves N_B, so its restriction extends the given p in the owner-named induced language. No global section or full-group restriction surjectivity is inferred.

claims.name: Separate ancillary owner-named homogeneity
claims.statement: For nonempty B, C23 extends every finite owner-preserving induced partial isomorphism, proving the owner-named union homogeneous in the current countable API scope. Empty B is direct. This proof is independent of the acl_N computation C17-C21 and does not require normalized packets or G-invariance for the pure induced language.

claims.name: Consolidated unary closure with branch-scoped hypotheses
claims.statement: C07 gives the original direct real equality; C13 gives harmless finite actual E-owner naming; C20 gives the induced-union equality under the ADDITIONAL normalized/G-invariant union hypotheses. Optional countable homogeneity C24 is separate support, not a premise of these equalities. This is exactly ONE new source export, not a duplicate of B012 or B025 and not an EPPA/HKN theorem.

overview_mermaid: F["Finite definable F"] --> R["Direct unary real acl"]
N["Normalized thin packets"] --> G["Total maps on G-invariant union"]

overview_notes: Gamma and F belong to the FULL invariant-equivalence lattice and need not be exact.
The specialized forward harmless proof is locally expanded; the broader countable provider type is not silently weakened.
A thin t_g can permute individually named owner predicates; definability is sufficient and named automorphism membership is not asserted.
The restriction image is a subgroup with the same point orbit as the ambient stabilizer. Neither injectivity nor surjectivity of restriction is needed.
B025 already uses its independent B012 route. This package completes one frozen Foundations II result without changing that dependency DAG.

controls.check: Bounded finite permutation orbit containment and restriction image checks, including nonfaithful restriction and strict subgroup/full-group differences.

Finite literal translation saturation, G-invariant owner sets, total definable function readouts and counterexamples to partial-packet unions/named-automorphism assumptions. These finite tests do not prove infinite acl, CCO or canonical hulls.
